notes: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md in full. The skill explains mTLS flow and CA hierarchy for service meshes and provides templates for Istio PeerAuthentication/DestinationRule, cert-manager ClusterIssuer and Certificate, SPIFFE/SPIRE server/agent config and Linkerd policy, plus certificate-rotation and debugging commands.

Medium: the shell blocks (references/details.md:242-273) are mostly read-only inspection (istioctl proxy-config, kubectl get, linkerd viz), but `kubectl rollout restart deployment/my-app` restarts a workload and `istioctl proxy-config log --level debug` changes proxy log level in the user's cluster. Acceptable because both are routine, reversible operations on the user's own mesh; all manifests are templates the user applies.

Users should know: the CA Secret template (references/details.md:100-109) holds placeholders for a base64 CA cert and private key that the user must supply securely; port-level DISABLE and skip-outbound-ports examples intentionally exempt specific ports from mTLS. `istioctl authn tls-check` has been removed in recent Istio releases.
